title: White musicians in Chicago clubs: Bix, Goodman and Jimmie Noone
summary: White musicians came to listen but rarely sat in; Cheatham met Bix and Benny Goodman at Jimmie Noone's club.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: What about, getting back to Chicago, there were a lot of white musicians around in those days. Did you play with white musicians, did they come to the Clubs or what --
They would come to the clubs every night.
But we never had an opportunity to play with them. Sometimes they would maybe one would sit in.
With the band. Once in a very, very rare time, most of them would come and hear.
I see. Did you ever meet people like Bix Biederbeck?
I met Bix, yes. I met Benny Goodman.
I loved Jimmy Noon; I loved to hear him, I was up there most all the time, that's where I met Bix and Benny Goodman.
Of course Benny Goodman listened to Jimmy Noon a lot.
